# Fixture rule: alpha route

Routes to a skill its own pack delivers, so a pack-legal install of `fx-alpha`
receives both the obligation and the artefact. Links into `core` are legal
because every install carries it: [shared](../skills/fx-core-shared/SKILL.md)
